request.action: Small golden campfire flames flicker gently in a seamless idle loop. Stone ring and logs stay perfectly still. Tiny embers rise. Keep the exact framing and transparent background.
The soup bubbles softly while a little steam curls upward and the wooden spoon gently stirs. The pot, tripod and framing stay fixed. Cozy seamless idle loop on transparency.

request.description: Cozy medieval fantasy inn common room, wide 16:9 establishing view, clean hand drawn pixel art at native 320x180, Wardenflame palette midnight navy shadows, muted moss green, warm rust wood and amber hearth light. Interior seen from a slightly elevated front view. Large stone fireplace on left, long table and low benches across middle for six adventurers, blankets and travel packs, candles, two clear windows on back wall with dark blue night outside, stairs or closed room doors at right. Keep the center foreground open for game characters. No people, no letters, no UI, no text. Crisp pixels, no blur.
